card.name: Linking words before descriptive or negated nouns
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "are" in "There are no specific antidotes" and "with" in plant descriptions. Also adjectives like "broad" or "sharp" that begin a descriptive phrase.

modes.label: There are no...
